payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates array maintaining counts; at each index computes max(keep all ones, keep all zeros, keep zeros till here + ones after) and takes global max over indices.
payload.rationale: Solution avoids backtracking or subset enumeration. It cleverly reduces problem to O(n) by testing all n+1 split points via prefix/suffix counts. This is not typical backtracking, so family mismatch.
